pagerbot: PagerDuty alert P-98123 fired — prod API 5xx error-rate spike in eu-west-1. Threshold breached (5m error_rate > 3%). https://pd.redwood/p/P-98123 :rotating_light:
maia: ack — I'm oncall, taking this (runbook: prod-5xx). starting triage now.
maia: @raj can you be on standby in case we need infra changes? I will check auth and gateway logs first.
incidentbot: Incidentbot: PD P-98123 acknowledged by maia.
kelly: quick metrics check — 5xx at 4.8% over last 2m, concentrated on POST /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings from eu-west1-a. latency p50/p95 stable. error classes: mostly 502/504 from upstream.
raj: looking at proxy traces — token-introspect-proxy showing elevated 502s to auth-db. will try a rolling restart in eu-west1a. command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/token-introspect-proxy -n prod-eu`
maia: routing plan: shift 30% of eu-west traffic for prod-api to us-west2 as temporary dampening while we fix auth. applying via routing console now.
kelly: customer impact: estimated ~2.7% of requests see 5xx (mostly short-lived retries). No large account outages reported yet but support may see increased tickets. Logging a brief CS note.
raj: restart done, new pods healthy. auth errors down ~60% in last 90s. backend traces show fewer upstream timeouts.
maia: monitoring after restart + weight shift — error-rate dropped to 0.9% over 3m window. keeping PD open for 20m of stable telemetry then will close. thanks folks :thumbsup:
incidentbot: Incidentbot: PD P-98123 status updated to "monitoring". Oncall rotation notified.
kelly: created support ticket CS-4521 with impacted endpoints, mitigation steps, and suggested customer message.
maia: leaving notes in runbook and will add a short post-incident summary after we let this settle.
